data.narrative:
Rivet Industries is a seed-stage Defense & Security frontier-tech company founded by Dave Marra. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

A peer-median approach was applied across 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables. The peer set spans valuations from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A), with UFORCE at $1.0B seed stage and Singularity at $400M Series A. The median valuation across these 4 peers is $700M, reflecting the capital intensity and strategic importance characteristic of the defense sector at seed and early growth stages.

The triangulated valuation range is $595M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $700M. However, this analysis is constrained by reliance on a single methodological approach. Key uncertainties include the heterogeneity of the peer set—particularly the wide dispersion from $125M to $4.0B—and the limited applicability of other standard VC valuation methods at this stage given sparse revenue or EBITDA data. Additional validation through revenue multiples, customer concentration analysis, or technology differentiation metrics would strengthen conviction. The stage-to-stage variance within the peer group also suggests material sensitivity to Rivet's specific progress metrics and market traction relative to comparables.
